text:
alex: Heads-up — planning the SDK v7 rollout next week. I'm drafting migration notes. Any surprising breaking changes we need to call out to users?

maria: High-level ask: auth, retries, streaming changes, language-specifics (node/python/java). Also want a short checklist for release notes.

sam: Quick summary from runtime/clients side: 
- sync clients removed for Python/Node (async-only clients now).
- default retry policy tightened (max 3 retriable attempts, exponential backoff).
- streaming framing changed: switched to SSE-like framing (old newline-delimited chunks won't parse).
- embeddings param rename: `model` -> `embedding_model` in some bindings.
- telemetry opt-in default flipped to opt-out for enterprise builds.

li: Node specifics: streaming API surface renamed (`client.stream` -> `client.subscribeStream`) and we also removed `node-fetch` polyfill; consumers must provide a fetch impl in older Node. Example migration snippet:
```js
// old
const s = client.stream({ model: 'gpt-xx', onDelta: cb })
// new
const s = client.subscribeStream({ embedding_model: 'gpt-xx', onDelta: cb })
```

sam: Python specifics: sync API removed (no more Client(...).generate()). Use `async with Client(...)` or run via `anyio.run`/`asyncio.run`. Auth header change: legacy `X-API-KEY` still accepted but we recommend `X-Redwood-Token`. Example:
```bash
curl -H "X-Redwood-Token: $TOKEN" 
  -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

alex: Is there a deprecation header our servers will emit so customers get early warnings?

ops-bot: Servers will emit `Warning: Redwood-Deprecation: v6-sync-clients; will-remove=2026-05-01` in responses and we'll send admin-email/console banners starting 2026-04-01.

maria: Good. We need a minimal migration checklist for docs and the changelog (single-paragraph + code samples per language). Can we also add automated lint/compat checks in the SDK repo to catch renamed params?

li: Added a PR that includes codemods for Node (rename `model` -> `embedding_model`, `stream` -> `subscribeStream`) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/7890. It also runs a thin AST replace so users can opt-in.

sam: For retries: warn users if they relied on infinite retries (some infra jobs did). We'll add a snippet showing how to re-enable previous behavior with `RetryPolicy(max_attempts=0)` but callout that it may cause long-running resource use.

alex: Can someone own the release notes paragraph + a tl;dr section for the dashboard? I can push the initial draft but need language checks.

maria: I can do the tl;dr and admin banner text. @li take node code samples, @sam take python. I'll coordinate PRs.

li: I'll also add a small migration guide in the top-level README with the codemod instructions and example `npx` command.

dev-bot: CI: nightly compatibility tests running on v7 branch — current status: 43/47 green, 4 flaky streaming tests failing (investigating).

sam: I'll look at the streaming test flakes first thing. Likely due to SSE parsing differences.

ops-bot: Tentative rollout window: 2026-04-10 -> 2026-04-17 (canary -> global). Please have docs + banners live before canary.

alex: Thanks all. Action items: 
- sam: fix streaming tests + Python samples (ETA 48h)
- li: finish Node codemod + samples (ETA 48h)
- maria: write dashboard banner + tl:dr (ETA 24h)
- alex: draft changelog paragraph and PR template (ETA 24h)

maria: I'll mark these in the release checklist and ping again tomorrow. :thumbsup:

alex: Great — pulling this into the v7 release notes now. If anyone finds any more last-minute breaking bits post-PR, drop them here.

li: small note — client versioning: we're bumping to 7.0.0 and adding a `compat` header so servers can report back if a client uses removed endpoints. Useful for telemetry.

alex: Perfect. Closing loop for now. We'll post a summary to #announcements once PRs merge.
